expert_notes: GeometryNodeInputMeshIsland evaluates at the active domain context — FACE domain when consumed by StoreNamedAttribute(domain='FACE'), POINT domain when consumed by SetPosition; no CaptureAttribute wrapper required
RandomValue(FLOAT_VECTOR, ID=IslandIndex, Seed=N) yields a constant-per-island random vector because all elements of an island share the same IslandIndex value

Storing island_index as a named INT attribute at FACE domain is the prerequisite for SeparateGeometry island selection — without materialising the field, SeparateGeometry has no stable per-face integer to compare against
GAP > 0 between tiles is mandatory: if tiles share vertices (GAP == 0), Blender merges connected geometry into fewer islands and IslandIndex counts change unexpectedly

export_attributes=True in bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf() is required; island_colour exports as _ISLAND_COLOUR and island_index as _ISLAND_INDEX in the glTF extras — accessible in Three.js via geometry.attributes._ISLAND_COLOUR
Island Count (second output of GeometryNodeInputMeshIsland) is a singular INT — not domain-specific — useful for normalising IslandIndex to 0..1 range: Index / (IslandCount - 1)
